description: This source file defines the MacNodeRuntime actor class, which manages various system functionalities such as camera control, browser proxy requests, location services, system commands, and UI interactions within a macOS environment for an OpenClaw-based application.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: An actor class that handles various runtime functionalities for the macOS Node, including system commands, media controls, location, permissions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main dispatcher for handling incoming commands, routing them to specific handlers based on command type.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the current main session key used for session-based operations.

methods.name: setEventSender
methods.description: Registers a callback to send event notifications.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to canvas operations such as present, hide, navigate, evalJS, snapshot.

methods.name: handleA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands for A2UI host interactions such as reset and push messages.

methods.name: handleBrowserProxyInvoke
methods.description: Handles browser proxy requests, forwarding them through the configured proxy request handler.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Processes camera-related commands: snap, clip, list devices.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location retrieval commands, including permission checks and fetching current location.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Manages screen recording commands, including starting recording sessions.

methods.name: mainActorServices
methods.description: Returns cached or newly fetched main actor services needed for certain operations.

methods.name: handleSystemRun
methods.description: Executes system commands, including environment validation, permission checks, and process execution.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Implements the 'which' functionality to locate executable paths for given binaries.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunApproval
methods.description: Handles user prompting and approval process for executing system commands.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsGet
methods.description: Retrieves current environment approval list data.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsSet
methods.description: Updates environment approval settings based on provided data.

methods.name: emitExecEvent
methods.description: Sends an execution event notification via the registered event sender.

methods.name: persistAllowlistPatterns
methods.description: Stores allowlist patterns persistently when applicable.

methods.name: recordAllowlistMatches
methods.description: Records allowlist matches into persistent storage for auditing or policy enforcement.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and requests permission for screen recording if required, emitting a denial event if not authorized.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
methods.description: Performs the actual system command execution and reports back with output, errors, and status.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into specified parameter object.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes objects into JSON strings for response payloads.

methods.name: canvasEnabled
methods.description: Checks if canvas features are enabled via user defaults.

methods.name: cameraEnabled
methods.description: Checks if camera features are enabled.

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Retrieves current location mode setting.

methods.name: locationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Checks if precise location fallback is enabled.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Constructs a standardized error response object.

methods.name: encodeCanvasSnapshot
methods.description: Encodes a given NSImage into specified format with optional scaling and quality settings.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Rescales an NSImage to maxWidth while maintaining aspect ratio.
